item.text: I’ll trace the existing organization, membership, event, and migration paths, then implement the handover within those conventions.

The recorded owner is stored separately from member roles, so acceptance needs to update both together. I’m also wiring billing and removal to that recorded ownership and keeping expiration checks at the exact seven-day boundary.
